code='''def transform(grid):
    # Read the colored markers at the recurring horizontal bands; each band
    # encodes one row of the reduced picture.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r)) > 1 and all(v == r[0] for v in r[:1])]
    # Marker bands are the rows containing the grid-line background, every four rows.
    bands = [i for i in range(h) if i % 4 == 2]
    cols = [1 + 7*j for j in range((w-1)//7)]
    base = next((v for r in grid for v in r if v not in (grid[0][0], grid[0][1])), grid[0][0])
    return [[grid[i][c] if grid[i][c] not in (grid[0][0], grid[0][1]) else grid[0][0] for c in cols] for i in bands]
'''
p.write_text(code)
